questions.question: How long have Ewa and Marek been together?
questions.explanation: Ewa says they have known each other for twenty-five years.

questions.question: What does Ewa hear in the podcast about the "built-in script"?
answers: That when someone deceives you, we think: "God has found me"
That divorce is the only way out
questions.explanation: Miłosz talks about the script: deceiver = "God has found me".

questions.question: What did Ewa think when Marek cooked her favourite dish?
answers: That she is grateful to him
That he had done something wrong and wanted to apologise
That something was wrong with him
questions.explanation: For years she thought he cooked because he had done something wrong.

questions.question: What does Marek propose instead of guessing?
answers: To accept that we don't know, and to ask
questions.explanation: He says: accept that we don't know, and ask "why?".

questions.question: What does Ewa write to her sister in the letter?
answers: That the biggest mistake was thinking she knew her husband inside out
That the podcast didn't help her at all
questions.explanation: The letter warns against thinking she knows her husband inside out.
